A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hypotensive agents used in hypertension are capable of reducing arterial pressure in both types of hemodynamics but the mechanism of their hypotensive effect depends on the type of hemodynamics.

The main takeaway from our work is that
in hypertension of the hypokinetic hemodynamic type the use of hypotensive drugs is not recommended.
the use of hypotensive drugs in hypertension should take into account the type of hemodynamics.
